goalDecisions.title: Kohlenhydratklassen strukturbezogen unterscheiden
goalDecisions.rationale: The formal aldose tree uses complete, correct OH-side patterns, explicitly not CIP or biosynthesis. Glucose/mannose share arabinose LRR and differ at C2; galactose follows lyxose LLR, xylose follows threose LR. The learner draws and transfers the classification. Glucose fermentation, starch sizing and cellulose fibres are specifically linked to monomer/linkage/physical properties. This fits structural carbohydrate classification; organismic formation remains the unchanged1051 photosynthesis contribution.

goalDecisions.title: Aminocarbonsäuren und Peptide nachweisen
goalDecisions.rationale: The paper-only Xanthoprotein addition improves assay selectivity without replacing original real ninhydrin/biuret duties. Suitable aromatic residues undergo nitration; yellow/orange colour is qualified by conditions and different residue response. Free tyrosine may be positive without peptide bonds, and Gly–Ala–Gly remains a peptide despite negative colour. No universal protein identity, denaturation or activity conclusion follows. A mandatory term alone does not impose concentrated nitric-acid learner execution.

goalDecisions.title: Chemische Untersuchungen selbst planen und durchführen
goalDecisions.rationale: Both additions fit actual own hypothesis-based investigation. A SekI tag alone is no scientific defect. Own hypotheses, justified plans under the supplied safe proposal, individual qualified release, actual comparisons and genuine records are required; copying a recipe or references is insufficient. Protein work includes all five source conditions and matched blanks, separates ethanol/heating and controls final volume/comparison temperature. Turbidity is not proof of complete denaturation,peptide cleavage or zero activity. The fresh half-ethanol case gives about24 versus48vol%. Oil work actually compares water/ethanol/heptane against blanks/time/loading and separates emulsion,clear second layer and molecular solution. Local SDS/equipment checks, ignition exclusion,waste and stop rules remain prerequisites. Neither experiment is claimed performed.
